instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-filesystem find in the folder Documents/Invoices for files whose name contains Ana Ruiz or invoice or timesheet, modified from 2026-11-02 to 30 days after 2026-11-08. Read only. Return each path with size and modified time. If there are no results, return an empty list and do not search any other folder.

said: I checked Documents/Invoices for files with Ana Ruiz, invoice or timesheet in the name, modified between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-08, and found no results. I have not searched other folders. You can (1) give me the exact file path of her latest invoice, (2) type the billed hours as date, start and end time, or (3) switch to Draft mode, which builds a timesheet from the Front Door camera only. Which would you like?

No problem. Without a bill I cannot run the invoice check. Here is what each option needs: (1) the exact path of the invoice file, for example Documents/Invoices/<file name>, if you know where it is saved; (2) the hours from the invoice typed out as date, start time and end time; or (3) Draft mode, which needs no bill and only shows the times the Front Door camera recognised Ana Ruiz on each day from Nov 2 to Nov 8 (New York time). Tell me which of these you want, or say stop to end here.
